verdict.rationale: Docs show no execution timeout, durability across deploys/crashes for long-lived tasks (e.g. AI chat sessions), waitpoint tokens for pausing runs for human approval, and retry/backoff configuration, all consistent with surviving restarts and waiting days. However, there is no explicit documented guarantee or independent test confirming state is preserved across worker/platform restarts specifically over multi-day waits, and one community comment (2023) explicitly notes wait/resume for long-running jobs was still a wishlist item at that time. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of multi-day wait survival across platform restarts, and explicit documentation confirming state persistence guarantees (not just no-timeout claims).
